cell.display_name: A123 high-power LFP pouch | 9 Ah | part undisclosed
cell.model_context: High-power thermal model assumes fast solid and electrolyte diffusion
cell.match_evidence: Paper identifies a 9 Ah A123 power pouch; the linked ORA archive supplies this study's CC tests. Exact part number and per-file cell serial are not disclosed.

coverage.ocp: Full-cell pseudo-OCP referenced in the paper; electrode potentials are conventionally allocated, not electrode-resolved measurements
coverage.diffusion: Fast-diffusion model assumption; no finite fitted diffusivity imported
coverage.kinetics: Not transcribed in this release; raw tests do not uniquely identify electrode kinetic laws
coverage.full_cell_tests: Ten CC charge/discharge files at 2, 4, 6, 8 and 10C

cell.note: OCP workbooks in the related GitHub code repository have no explicit file-level reuse license located here; indexed as references rather than silently redistributed. Never substitute AMP20M1HD-A parameters.

full_cell_tests.current_convention: Source signed current retained: charge positive, discharge negative; checked against protocol and voltage trend.
full_cell_tests.processing: No voltage/current smoothing, resampling, or row deletion. Source NaNs become empty CSV fields; U denotes unknown current mode. Time is relative sample index on the documented 1 Hz timebase. Celsius temperatures converted to kelvin. Full MAT/ZIP originals remain checksum-pinned at the source.
full_cell_tests.temperature_definition: Fourth Expivium column; archive README calls this reference temperature, related repository calls it mean temperature. Retained as a source-reported temperature; exact sensor/ROI identity is unresolved.

oxford-9ah-data.title: Oxford high-power A123 LFP/graphite pouch-cell experiments
oxford-9ah-data.role: Ten CC charge/discharge experiments at 2/4/6/8/10C. The archive README supplies the 1 Hz timebase and license. The paper identifies A123 9 Ah; no part number is established.

oxford-9ah-paper.title: Electrochemical-thermal modelling of high power Li-ion pouch cells
oxford-9ah-paper.role: A123 9 Ah power pouch cell; the model assumes fast diffusion rather than identifying a finite diffusion coefficient. Its full-cell pseudo-OCP is allocated between electrodes as a modeling convention, not measured electrode OCPs.
